metadata.source: Congressional Research Service, RAND, CSIS, public government reports, industry analysis
metadata.note: Annual all-source investment (government + corporate R&D + VC) in USD billions; China figures are approximations. This is a deliberately conservative series — broader 'quantum technologies' accounting (incl. sensing/comms and China's headline state funds) puts 2025 nearer $33B (ResearchAndMarkets/QBN). 2026 is a partial year with no clean full-year total yet: private VC is decelerating from 2025's record (~$4.9B, a doubling), while government commitments keep rising (EU >EUR 43B public funding pledged for 2026). No 2026 annual row is entered until a methodology-consistent full-year figure exists.
